nodes.description: Homozygous candidate spectrum variant in Brazilian proband RC-26 with prelingual mild-to-moderate hearing loss, camptodactyly and microcephaly but average stature. The authors considered it likely pathogenic/causative, while their table records VUS or LP/VUS database assessments. No functional assay was reported; this observation does not establish classic CATSHL or a universal loss-of-function effect for substitutions at residue 540.

nodes.description: CRISPR/Cas9 AB-background mutants show craniofacial cartilage dysplasia, delayed ossification and cranial bone islands. Ceratohyal cartilage is elongated, but surviving adults have smaller overall body size, with severe jaw deformity affecting feeding. Weberian apparatus and swim bladder abnormalities suggest altered hearing; auditory function itself was not measured.
